📂
Click or drag a file here
Supports .csv, .xlsx, .xls
Required column: Name or SKU — used to match items.
Optional columns: Stock (or Qty) · Cost/Unit · Category · Supplier — only provided columns will be updated.
REMARKS column: Rows with "for removal" in REMARKS will be deleted from the tracker.
Tip: Export the current inventory CSV to use as a template.

🕒 Inventory Snapshot

See what every item's quantity was at a specific date and time, reconstructed from the transaction log.

Quantities are reconstructed from logged transactions as of the moment chosen — accuracy depends on every transaction having been logged. Items created after this time are marked "Not yet added." Deleted items aren't included. Unit cost/value shown uses today's cost, not the cost in effect at that time.
Item SKU Qty Unit Cost (today) Est. Value (today's cost)

Adjustments covers manual qty edits, physical-count corrections, and reconciliation sign-offs logged that day — the sign shows whether it increased (+) or decreased (−) inventory.
System quantities are reconstructed from the transaction log as of the chosen moment (same method as Inventory Snapshot). Enter the physical count and a reason for every item with a discrepancy, then Save Draft to keep working on it, or Finalize & Sign Off to lock it in as an official record.

Settings

Change passwords for each role.

Contact info shown to users when they need help.

Default names pre-filled on every Purchase Order — used by both the manual Reorder cart form and the Shelfie's PO action, unless someone types a different name for a one-off PO. Leave blank to require typing a name every time.

DR scans → Google Drive. Paste the Web app URL of the SupplyBase DR uploader (Apps Script) so scanned delivery receipts are saved to the shared drive. Leave blank to turn DR scanning off.

What User accounts are allowed to do.

Which tabs each role can see. Superuser always sees all tabs.

🧰 Asset Management access

Which roles can open Assets, and how much they can do there. Superuser always has full access. Changes apply right away (open screens update on their next refresh).

🎄 Season mode

Christmas look (login map, lights, Santa hats, countdown, Dashboard banner), SupplyBase Wrapped, and the Dashboard fun facts. Applies to everyone; each person can still turn the moving effects off for themselves.

💬 Shelfie in Slack

Who asked Shelfie in Slack and when. What they asked isn't recorded.

Shows only the items you pick below — everywhere, for every account (Inventory, pickers, reports, requests, exports). Nothing is deleted; turning it off restores the full catalog instantly.

Connect to Supabase

Set this up once — all users share the same database.

First-time setup (superuser only):
1. Go to supabase.com → New project (free tier is fine)
2. In SQL Editor, run the setup SQL from your setup guide
3. Go to Project Settings → API
4. Copy the Project URL and the anon / public key
5. Paste both below and click Connect

All users connect to the same Supabase project. Data syncs in real time.
